hosts.fantasy: Rush a priority target with fast punches, kicks, and immediate re-entry.
hosts.strength: Fast unarmed cadence, short recovery, strong early possession readability.
hosts.weakness: Very short reach and limited crowd coverage.

hosts.fantasy: Break a close formation with elite martial strikes and a forward sonic wave.
hosts.strength: Heavy close pressure plus the family's only original sonic-wave range option.
hosts.weakness: Slower cadence and a committed recovery after the wave.

hosts.fantasy: Lob delayed explosives into clusters and own the landing zone.
hosts.strength: Excellent cluster damage and obstacle bypass.
hosts.weakness: Delayed impact and poor performance against fast isolated targets.

hosts.fantasy: Align enemies and burn through them with one precise beam.
hosts.strength: Instant lane damage, perfect line penetration, boss consistency.
hosts.weakness: Requires stop time and loses value when targets spread sideways.

hosts.fantasy: Maintain continuous suppression while controlling distance.
hosts.strength: Best sustained projectile pressure and excellent generic card coverage.
hosts.weakness: Low stagger per bullet and vulnerable during reload recovery.

hosts.fantasy: Launch slow hunters that chase priority targets and detonate on arrival.
hosts.strength: Reliable homing, strong boss damage, safe long range.
hosts.weakness: Slow cadence and overkill against weak enemies.

hosts.fantasy: Freeze a narrow lane with piercing cold breath.
hosts.strength: Reliable slow, line control, pierce utility.
hosts.weakness: Moderate damage and weak side coverage.

hosts.fantasy: Seed corrosive pools that punish enemies for holding ground.
hosts.strength: Persistent area pressure and armor erosion.
hosts.weakness: Slow projectile and weak immediate burst.

hosts.fantasy: Commit to close range and erase a crowd with a wide fire cone.
hosts.strength: High close-range area damage and burn coverage.
hosts.weakness: Short reach, slow turn, and risky positioning.

hosts.fantasy: Delete priority targets with deliberate pistol shots.
hosts.strength: Fast target acquisition, strong single-shot coefficient, clean low-HP finishing.
hosts.weakness: Limited crowd control and little projectile synergy beyond fundamentals.

hosts.fantasy: Sweep a crowd with a controllable stream of submachine-gun fire.
hosts.strength: High bullet volume, spread coverage, excellent on-hit card use.
hosts.weakness: Lower accuracy and weaker per-bullet stagger.

hosts.fantasy: Float above ground danger, reposition calmly, then punish enemies with disciplined palm shockwaves.
hosts.strength: Changes ground-navigation rules, creates space with knockback, and remains safe without relying on top-tier DPS.
hosts.weakness: Low raw DPS, short effective range, and no protection from normal bullets, beams, explosions, Boss attacks, or aerial-hit attacks.

hosts.fantasy: Stop briefly, perform an evasive acrobatic firing motion, and deliver a precise shot without losing positional control.
hosts.strength: Acrobatic precision cadence, fast recovery, and strong compatibility with player-controlled repositioning.
hosts.weakness: Lower raw room DPS than planted gun Hosts and limited crowd coverage.

hosts.fantasy: Deliver acrobatic suppression without surrendering player control.
hosts.strength: Short mobile-compatible bursts, wider sweep, and faster recovery than planted machine-gun fire.
hosts.weakness: Lower firing density than Commando Machine Gun and weaker single-target precision.

hosts.fantasy: Plant dark magic that spreads punishment through clustered enemies.
hosts.strength: Strong delayed area damage and status compatibility.
hosts.weakness: Slow immediate response and weaker against constantly moving targets.

hosts.fantasy: Pierce one target with clean light, then refract the shot into a second threat.
hosts.strength: Distinct precision pierce-to-refraction geometry, strong two-target efficiency, and readable ranged control.
hosts.weakness: Weaker than Commando Laser on a perfect straight line and loses refraction value when no second target exists.

hosts.fantasy: Commit to close range and overwhelm targets with chain pressure.
hosts.strength: Wide tethered melee reach, pull utility, strong crowd manipulation.
hosts.weakness: Risky close positioning and weaker boss displacement utility.

hosts.fantasy: Cut through moving targets with a fast fan of returning shuriken.
hosts.strength: Fast cadence, multi-target fan, excellent ricochet compatibility.
hosts.weakness: Lower durability and weak heavy stagger.

hosts.fantasy: Anchor at long range and pressure priority targets with arm-mounted rockets.
hosts.strength: Long-range explosive pressure, clear projectile identity, strong boss consistency.
hosts.weakness: Slow launch cadence and vulnerable recovery after firing.

hosts.fantasy: Step into melee range and clear space with powerful bat swings.
hosts.strength: Wide bat arc, strong knockback, clear close-range possession value.
hosts.weakness: No original ranged ball attack and limited reach against spread targets.

hosts.fantasy: Slow the room with drifting ice fans and finish frozen lanes safely.
hosts.strength: Wide slow coverage, safe kiting, excellent ice cards.
hosts.weakness: Low burst and reduced value against status-resistant targets.

hosts.fantasy: Drain one dangerous target and convert pressure into survival.
hosts.strength: Self-sustain, reliable boss value, strong low-HP recovery.
hosts.weakness: Lower crowd clear and vulnerable before the drain connects.

hosts.fantasy: Reap a wide arc and leave a curse that makes every next strike matter.
hosts.strength: Wide melee reach, strong status pressure, high elite payoff.
hosts.weakness: Slow wind-up and dangerous close commitment.
